summary: The counter still opens an account. The app is where a passport-only line stops.

items.task: Opening an account at a branch
items.note: Passport and registration card, in person. Not dependent on phone verification.

items.task: Opening an account in the app
items.note: The flow asks for phone identity verification before the identity document step, so it halts there.

items.task: Mobile OTP issuance and simple authentication
items.note: Registration on these depends on a line the carrier can vouch for.
Product-dependent, and the ones that ask for verification cannot be completed remotely.

source: Bank account opening procedures for foreign nationals; Korea Communications Commission on identity verification using alternatives to the resident registration number
